SEARCH
Package de.nexus.antixray.api

Schnittstelle MiningStats

public interface MiningStats
What the x-ray detection has counted for one player, as an immutable snapshot taken by NexusAntiXRayApi.getStats(java.util.UUID).

The detection works with bait veins: fake ore veins of the types listed under xray-detection.bait-ores. Only an x-ray client can see them, so a player who keeps digging into them is suspicious. A vein counts once within the window, however many of its blocks the player uncovers. The measure is the number of bait veins per 100 mined blocks (the blocks listed under xray-detection.mined-blocks, mostly stone and deepslate).

Two scopes are reported:

  • the window: the last getWindowMinutes() minutes. Alerts are decided on these numbers.
  • the totals: everything since NexusAntiXRay started counting this player in the current server run. They start at zero after a server restart. The totals across restarts are a different object, StoredMiningStats, loaded with NexusAntiXRayApi.loadStats(java.util.UUID).
The object never changes after it was created and may be passed to any thread. NexusAntiXRay implements this interface; later versions of the API may add methods.
Seit:
1.0.0
